[2:52PM] #Ejigbo  #TrafficUpdate 

From Ikotun Roundabout towards Oju Odo, both inward and outward lanes are experiencing moderate traffic due to ongoing commercial activities; however, vehicles are still moving. Conversely, the outward flow from Ikotun Roundabout towards Old Garage is currently smooth, while the return journey on Old Garage inward to Ikotun Roundabout is somewhat busy due to commercial bus operations, though traffic flow remains consistent.

The route spanning Synagogue to Ilewe, Cele, Egbe, Power Line, Iyana Ejigbo, NNPC Junction, and Mobolaji Johnson Avenue (Mobostic) is presently clear and operating without issues. Similarly, Jakande Gate outward towards the roundabout is also experiencing smooth traffic flow, with LASTMA officers actively managing the area. 

The return route from the roundabout inward towards NNPC Junction, continuing to Iyana Ejigbo, Pipeline, Cele, Egbe, and finally Oju Odo and Ikotun, is currently free of any impediments and maintaining good traffic conditions.
Our men are present at various key locations ensuring ease of movement.

#FollowLASTMA

[3:48PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

The Cele Ijesha link bridge is experiencing fast and light traffic, with the flow continuing at a brisk pace towards Ijesha. Similarly, the stretch of road from Cele, past the Rain Oil petrol station, and connecting to Ago Palace is reporting fast traffic in both directions.

 Commuters traveling from the 5 Star area towards the under bridge at Iyana Isolo can also expect a fast flow of traffic. The Daleko-Mushin bridge is currently experiencing fast and steady traffic conditions.

Furthermore, the extensive stretch of road from the Lasutech roundabout, through Limca Junction, Aiye, Omonije, College, Ishaga, Mustapha, Ile Ibadan, Ire Akari, and Kogberegbe, is reported to have good traffic flow, with a fast return journey flow.

 The Oke-Afa bridge and its connection to Pako are both experiencing fast traffic conditions in both onward and return directions. Moving from Pako towards Akiti and the Chemist bus-stops, the traffic flow is good, with a fast return journey also reported. 

Journeys originating from the Ago roundabout and connecting to Ibeh road are proceeding well in both directions. Lastly, the stretch from Ilasa-Transformer linking to Apata Junction is experiencing fast traffic flow, and the same conditions apply to the return journey.

There are no impediments in these areas at present. 

#FollowLASTMA

[4:25PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

  The CMS bridge leading inward towards the Offin Canal market stretch and further to Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection is experiencing smooth traffic flow. A steady pace of traffic is observed on Broad Street from the Apongbon underbridge, connecting to the Offin Canal market, Olowogbowo, and the broader Offin Canal market area.

 Additionally, there is good movement on the Eko bridge near the NEPA intersection heading inward towards Apongbon. Descending the Eko bridge towards CMS, the route through Elegbeta Mini stadium and the Ebute-Ero market is also clear and flowing well.

 Furthermore, the area from the Ebute-Ero market towards Leventis, through the UBA roundabout, and connecting to both inner and outer Marina is reported to have good traffic conditions. Currently, there are no reported impediments to traffic, and personnel are visible on ground to manage the flow.

#FollowLASTMA
